phishing.label: AI Phishing Shield
phishing.description: Detects phishing SMS, emails, malicious URLs, and brand impersonation. Highest weight because phishing is the most common entry point in KZ financial fraud chains.

leak.label: Leak Sentinel
leak.description: Checks emails, phones, and usernames against known breach databases. High weight because credential exposure dramatically increases attack success probability.

anomaly.label: Behavioral Anomaly Engine
anomaly.description: Detects impossible travel, new device logins, suspicious IP addresses, and abnormal login times. Equal weight to leak — unauthorized access is a direct fraud signal.

deepfake.label: Deepfake Guard
deepfake.description: Detects synthetic voice and video used to impersonate bank officers or government officials. Weighted lower because deepfake calls typically follow phishing — a corroborating signal.

network.label: Network Threat Monitor
network.description: Identifies C2-like outbound traffic, botnet beaconing, suspicious ports, and Tor exit node communication. Infrastructure-level signal — strong when correlated with identity signals.

logs.label: Log Intelligence Engine
logs.description: Analyzes authentication logs for brute-force bursts, privilege escalation, and account takeover patterns. Corroborating signal — rarely the first indicator, but confirms active attack.
